en.answer: Yes, you can. Since the original Level of <<5234>> is 4 as written in its text, you will Special Summon a Level 4 Pendulum Monster from your Deck.
en.question: Can I activate <<11739>> by sending <<5234>> to the Graveyard while it is treated as a monster?
en.title: Can I activate <<11739>> by sending <<5234>> to the Graveyard while it is treated as a monster?

ja.answer:
できます。

「<<5234>>」はカードテキストに記載されたレベル４が元々のレベルとなりますので、デッキからレベル４のペンデュラムモンスターを特殊召喚する事になります。
